name: Panoptic nuScenes
description: Panoptic nuScenes is a large-scale benchmark dataset for LiDAR panoptic segmentation and tracking in urban environments. It extends the nuScenes dataset with point-wise ground truth annotations for semantic segmentation, panoptic segmentation, and tracking, and introduces a novel instance-centric PAT metric for evaluation.
reputation: A well-known extension of nuScenes that is commonly used in 3D panoptic segmentation and tracking research.
notes: Addresses lack of diversity and dynamic object instances in existing datasets; provides strong baselines and an online evaluation server.
